lines.zh: 我每挪一步，肚子都发出湿响。
lines.en: Every step I take, my belly makes a wet sound.

lines.zh: 爪下压着草叶，声音一路跟着我。
lines.en: Grass bends under my claws, and the sound follows me.

lines.zh: 我沿着树根慢慢走，找会动的小点心。
lines.en: I creep along the roots, hunting for little moving snacks.

lines.zh: 吞东西的声响，比脚步声还响。
lines.en: The sound of swallowing is louder than my footsteps.

lines.zh: 走两步停一下，听草丛里有没有沙沙声。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to hear rustling in the grass.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还留着半只虫的味儿。
lines.en: Half a bug's taste still lingers in my mouth.

lines.zh: 肚子拖得低，擦过湿润的落叶。
lines.en: My belly drags low over the damp fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，怕磕到自己的牙。
lines.en: I walk around the stones so I don't chip a tooth.

lines.zh: 脚步声闷闷的，像有人在敲空木桶。
lines.en: My steps thud like someone tapping an empty barrel.

lines.zh: 前面有影子在动，我加快了一点。
lines.en: A shadow moves ahead, so I quicken my pace.

lines.zh: 我边走边咽口水，声响自己听得见。
lines.en: I swallow as I walk, loud enough for me to hear.

lines.zh: 这条路我闻过，尽头有肥虫子。
lines.en: I know this path by scent; fat grubs wait at its end.

lines.zh: 四只短腿交替，身子左右晃。
lines.en: My four short legs trade places and my body sways.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，反正点心也跑不快。
lines.en: I go slowly; snacks are not fast either.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子挪过一根倒木。
lines.en: I drag my belly over a fallen log.

lines.zh: 每走一步，喉里都咕一声。
lines.en: Every step, a gulp sounds in my throat.

lines.zh: 我打个嗝，空气里有虫壳的味。
lines.en: I burp, and the air tastes of beetle shells.

lines.zh: 我舔干净嘴角，再舔一遍。
lines.en: I lick my lips clean, then lick them again.

lines.zh: 晒着太阳，肚子慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: In the sun my belly slowly swells.

lines.zh: 我听见远处虫鸣，耳朵动了动。
lines.en: I hear insects far off and my ears twitch.

lines.zh: 消化的时候，身体里咕噜咕噜响。
lines.en: While digesting, my insides gurgle and rumble.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，想刚才那只跑掉的虫。
lines.en: I tilt my head, thinking of the bug that got away.

lines.zh: 树荫很凉，我把身子摊平。
lines.en: The shade is cool, so I spread myself flat.

lines.zh: 我用后爪挠挠肚皮，挠不到。
lines.en: I scratch my belly with a hind claw and miss.

lines.zh: 有东西在土里动，我暂时不动。
lines.en: Something stirs in the soil; for now I stay still.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，只是习惯。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it out of habit.

lines.zh: 风带来一股味道，不像食物。
lines.en: The wind brings a smell that is not food.

lines.zh: 我数着眼前飞过的虫，数到三。
lines.en: I count the bugs flying past and lose count at three.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我自己的呼吸也很响。
lines.en: When all is quiet, even my breathing sounds loud.

lines.zh: 我趴着，等下一顿自己送上门。
lines.en: I lie here and let the next meal come to me.

lines.zh: 我眯着眼，嘴里还有壳。
lines.en: I squint, shell still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 有只苍蝇在转，我先不动。
lines.en: A fly circles; I stay still for now.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我闻你的鞋。
lines.en: You stand still, so I sniff your boots.

lines.zh: 你身上没有虫味，只有火把味。
lines.en: You smell of torch smoke, not of bugs.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，嘴还半张着。
lines.en: I look up at you with my mouth half open.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是藏着什么会动的？
lines.en: Are you hiding something wriggly in your hand?

lines.zh: 我把鼻子贴到你口袋边，闻个不停。
lines.en: I press my nose to your pocket and sniff without end.

lines.zh: 你比虫子大太多，我不咬你。
lines.en: You are far too big to bite, so I won't.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就往前挪半步。
lines.en: When you crouch, I shuffle half a step closer.

lines.zh: 我歪头，判断你会不会喂我。
lines.en: I tilt my head, deciding whether you will feed me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我背上，我没躲。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my back and I don't flinch.

lines.zh: 我看着你，喉咙里发出轻轻一声。
lines.en: I watch you and make one soft sound in my throat.

lines.zh: 你走近时，我舔了舔鼻子。
lines.en: As you come closer, I lick my nose.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在地上，继续看你。
lines.en: I rest my head on the ground and keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我疼得整个肚子都缩了。
lines.en: The pain pulls my whole belly inward.

lines.zh: 一声惨叫，比平常响得多。
lines.en: A cry escapes me, far louder than usual.

lines.zh: 我滚到一边，草叶扎进伤口。
lines.en: I roll aside and grass stabs the wound.

lines.zh: 谁打我？我嘴里还咬着半只虫。
lines.en: Who hit me? I still have half a bug in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，把软肚子藏起来。
lines.en: I curl up to hide my soft belly.

lines.zh: 这一下让我连打嗝都疼。
lines.en: This blow makes even burping hurt.

lines.zh: 我撑起前腿，后腿还在打颤。
lines.en: I push up on my front legs while my hind legs tremble.

lines.zh: 血滴在落叶上，闻着像我。
lines.en: Blood drips on the leaves and smells like me.

lines.zh: 我退到树根后，先舔舔伤口。
lines.en: I retreat behind the roots and lick the wound.

lines.zh: 疼，但我不想丢掉嘴里的东西。
lines.en: It hurts, but I won't drop what's in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这味道！我整个身子都转过来了。
lines.en: That smell! My whole body turns toward it.

lines.zh: 有虫，有虫，我闻到了。
lines.en: Bugs, bugs, I can smell them.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等你把那只虫丢下来。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open, waiting for you to drop that bug.

lines.zh: 我跟着那味道，一步都不肯落。
lines.en: I follow that smell and refuse to fall behind.

lines.zh: 口水滴在土上，我顾不上了。
lines.en: Drool drips onto the dirt and I don't care.

lines.zh: 给我一口，就一口，我保证。
lines.en: Just one bite, only one, I promise.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的腿，喉咙里咕噜响。
lines.en: I rub against your leg, gurgling in my throat.

lines.zh: 那东西还在动，我的眼睛发直。
lines.en: The thing is still wriggling and my eyes go fixed.

lines.zh: 我跳起来够你的手，够不到。
lines.en: I hop for your hand and fall short.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的鼻子就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my nose follows.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只在旁边等着。
lines.en: I won't snatch it; I'll just wait beside you.

lines.zh: 胃里先响了一声，替我催你。
lines.en: My stomach rumbles first, hurrying you for me.

lines.zh: 甜的、腥的，我都要。
lines.en: Sweet or fishy, I want all of it.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我就踮起脚。
lines.en: You raise the food and I rise on my toes.

lines.zh: 那味道一飘过来，我腿就软了。
lines.en: That smell drifts over and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 我伸长了脖子，够不着。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and still cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我的肚子撞上你，弹了一下。
lines.en: My belly bumps you and bounces back.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，嘴里还在道歉。
lines.en: I back away two steps, still mumbling an apology.

lines.zh: 撞得我牙齿磕在一起，好疼。
lines.en: The knock clacks my teeth together, and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我太专心闻味道，没看见你。
lines.en: I was too busy sniffing and never saw you.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过去，肚子擦过你的腿。
lines.en: I squeeze past, belly brushing your leg.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，我停在原地眨眼。
lines.en: A dull thud, and I stand there blinking.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪，把路让给你。
lines.en: I shuffle aside and give you the path.

lines.zh: 撞完我先摸摸自己的鼻子。
lines.en: After the bump I check my own nose first.

lines.zh: 我以为那是个树桩，原来是你。
lines.en: I thought that was a stump, but it was you.

lines.zh: 我肚皮朝天躺了一会儿，才翻回来。
lines.en: I lie belly-up a while before rolling back over.

lines.zh: 她来了，我的声音都变了调。
lines.en: She arrives, and my voice changes pitch.

lines.zh: 我们互相闻，谁也没先开口。
lines.en: We sniff each other and neither speaks first.

lines.zh: 两只一起走，草丛响成一片。
lines.en: Two of us walking make the grass rustle loudly.

lines.zh: 我把找到的虫推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the bug I found toward her.

lines.zh: 她吃，我在旁边守着。
lines.en: She eats, and I keep watch beside her.

lines.zh: 我们的叫声一高一低，对上了。
lines.en: Our calls rise and fall until they match.

lines.zh: 她用头蹭我，我差点站不稳。
lines.en: She nudges me with her head and I almost topple.

lines.zh: 我们一起趴在树根边晒太阳。
lines.en: We lie together by the roots in the sun.

lines.zh: 她走慢一点，我就跟着慢下来。
lines.en: When she slows, I slow down with her.

lines.zh: 这窝草够软，够我们俩挤。
lines.en: This patch of grass is soft enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我衔起它，又觉得不该留着。
lines.en: I pick it up, then decide I shouldn't keep it.

lines.zh: 东西在我嘴里滑了一下，掉了。
lines.en: It slips in my mouth and drops out.

lines.zh: 我的爪子太短，夹不住它。
lines.en: My claws are too short to grip it.

lines.zh: 我吞下去，就再也拿不出来了。
lines.en: If I swallow it, it never comes back out.

lines.zh: 我对亮闪闪的东西没兴趣，只对肉。
lines.en: Shiny things don't interest me; only meat does.

lines.zh: 它卡在我牙缝里，难受。
lines.en: It's stuck between my teeth and bothers me.

lines.zh: 我把它放回地上，用鼻子推给你。
lines.en: I set it down and nudge it toward you.

lines.zh: 我叼着走两步，又松口。
lines.en: I carry it two steps, then let go.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，只好叼在嘴上。
lines.en: I have no pockets, so I carry it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西不好吃，我吐了出来。
lines.en: This thing tastes wrong, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我看见它了，一只肥虫子。
lines.en: I see it: one fat grub.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肚子贴到地。
lines.en: I lower myself until my belly touches ground.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住，别让它跑了。
lines.en: Eyes locked; don't let it get away.

lines.zh: 我压住气，肚子还是咕噜响了一声。
lines.en: I hold my breath, but my belly still gurgles once.

lines.zh: 它动了一下，我的牙已经张开。
lines.en: It twitches, and my teeth are already open.

lines.zh: 距离三块土，够我扑一次。
lines.en: Three blocks away, close enough for one lunge.

lines.zh: 胃先替我做了决定。
lines.en: My stomach makes the decision for me.

lines.zh: 我听见它啃叶子的声音了。
lines.en: I can hear it chewing a leaf.

lines.zh: 它钻进草里，我记住了位置。
lines.en: It ducks into the grass and I mark the spot.

lines.zh: 这次不能再让它溜走。
lines.en: This time it will not slip away.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有尾巴在抖。
lines.en: I stay frozen; only my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 它再挪一寸，我就能咬到。
lines.en: One more inch of crawling and my teeth can reach.

lines.zh: 它回头了，我立刻停下。
lines.en: It looks back, and I stop at once.

lines.zh: 我算着它下一次抬头的空当。
lines.en: I time the gap before it looks up again.

lines.zh: 嘴里开始积口水，我咽下去。
lines.en: Saliva pools in my mouth and I swallow.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸压得很低很慢。
lines.en: I keep my breathing low and slow.

lines.zh: 那只虫还没发现我。
lines.en: The bug still has no idea I am here.

lines.zh: 影子盖住它了，是时候了。
lines.en: My shadow covers it; the moment is here.

lines.zh: 等它低头啃第三口，我就扑。
lines.en: When it lowers its head for a third bite, I pounce.

lines.zh: 它停在那儿，正好。
lines.en: It stops right there, perfect.

lines.zh: 我合上嘴，壳在齿间碎了。
lines.en: I snap my jaws shut and the shell cracks.

lines.zh: 扑过去时，我整个肚子都晃。
lines.en: As I lunge, my whole belly wobbles.

lines.zh: 咬空了，我啃了一嘴泥。
lines.en: I miss and get a mouthful of dirt.

lines.zh: 它在我嘴里还蹬腿。
lines.en: It is still kicking inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把它吞下去。
lines.en: I shake my head and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 这一口咬得我自己都听见响。
lines.en: I hear this bite land as clearly as anyone.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张到极限，一口盖住它。
lines.en: I stretch my mouth wide and close over it.

lines.zh: 嚼两下，世界安静了。
lines.en: Two chews, and the world goes quiet.

lines.zh: 牙撞在石头上，我哼了一声。
lines.en: My teeth hit stone and I grunt.

lines.zh: 我舔舔嘴角，没剩什么。
lines.en: I lick my lips; nothing is left.

lines.zh: 我从草里钻出来，先打了个嗝。
lines.en: I push out of the grass and burp first.

lines.zh: 落地时，肚子先着地。
lines.en: My belly lands before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 第一声听见的是自己的肚子。
lines.en: The first sound I hear is my own stomach.

lines.zh: 我抬头，四处都是能吃的。
lines.en: I look around and everywhere is something edible.

lines.zh: 湿土的味道让我立刻清醒。
lines.en: The smell of wet soil wakes me at once.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的草屑。
lines.en: I shake the grass bits off my back.

lines.zh: 这里的虫比我家乡的肥。
lines.en: The bugs here are fatter than back home.

lines.zh: 我试着挪了两步，站稳了。
lines.en: I try two steps and find my footing.

lines.zh: 有风声，有虫声，我都要听。
lines.en: Wind, insects — I want to hear it all.

lines.zh: 新地方，第一顿得吃好。
lines.en: New place; the first meal should be a good one.

lines.zh: 皮毛焦了一块，味道很难闻。
lines.en: A patch of my fur is scorched and smells awful.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，肚子先挨了一下。
lines.en: I fell from a height and my belly took it.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我拼命划腿。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 气浪推着我滚，撞在树根上才停。
lines.en: The blast wave rolls me until a root stops me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我侧腹，我咬住它。
lines.en: Something pierces my flank and I bite at it.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进骨头，不是疼，是麻。
lines.en: That force seeps into my bones: numb, not sharp.

lines.zh: 我翻遍落叶，一只虫也没找到。
lines.en: I search the leaves and find not one bug.

lines.zh: 白光劈下，我浑身的毛都立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every hair on me stands.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，也没有虫，只有空。
lines.en: No soil, no bugs here, only emptiness.
